```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(RODBC)

# path to unzipped .accdb file
# using normalize path  bc Windows ODBC driver was being weird
db_path <- normalizePath("../data_raw/IPEDS201920.accdb")

```

```{r}
# establishing connection to db
con <- odbcConnectAccess2007(db_path)

# checking tables inside
table_list <- sqlTables(con, tableType = "TABLE")
print(table_list$TABLE_NAME)
```
